## FAQ (Common Customer Questions)

**Q: How often should I get a haircut or styling?**
A: Every 4-6 weeks for haircuts. Color treatments and styling frequency depends on hair type.

**Q: What is included in a bridal makeup package?**
A: Pre-wedding consultation, trial makeup session, wedding day makeup and hairstyling, touch-up kit, and on-location services. Packages also available for bridesmaids and family.

**Q: Do you use premium products for treatments?**
A: Yes, we exclusively use internationally recognized premium brands for all services.

**Q: How long does a typical salon session take?**
A: Haircut 45-60 min, color treatments 2-3 hours, bridal makeup 2-3 hours, full beauty treatments 3-4 hours.

**Q: Do you offer home service for bridal makeup?**
A: Yes, bridal makeup home service and on-location/destination wedding services are available (outdoor charges: ₹3,000).

**Q: What are your working hours?**
A: Open daily 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM, Monday through Sunday (7 days a week).

**Q: Do you have parking available?**
A: Yes, ground floor parking is available.

**Q: What languages do your staff speak?**
A: English, Tamil, and Hindi.

**Q: How do I book an appointment?**
A: Online via Welns.io booking link, WhatsApp (+91 98400 88867), phone call (+91-9840088867), or walk-in.
